parameters.name: ExecAction
parameters.description:
Set the action for this execution, default is **exec**. Values:
- **exec**: Execute. - **terminate**: Terminate.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the baseline check policy.

>  You can call the [DescribeStrategy](~~DescribeStrategy~~) operation to query the IDs of baseline check policies.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas exec-strategy --lang zh --strategy-id 215421 --exec-action terminate --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ExecStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --ExecAction terminate --StrategyId 215421 --Lang zh
